translations.literal: Males and females three and below were yellow, ten and below minor, seventeen and below middling, eighteen and above adult laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Males and females three and below were 'yellow,' ten and below 'minor,' seventeen and below 'middling,' eighteen and above adult laborers.

sentences.zh: 丁從課役，六十為老，乃免。

translations.literal: Adult laborers bore levies and corvée; at sixty one was elderly and exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Adult laborers bore levies and corvée; at sixty one became elderly and was exempt.

sentences.zh: 自諸王已下，至于都督，皆給永業田，各有差。

translations.literal: From princes down to governors, all were granted perpetual-estate fields, each with differences.
translations.idiomatic: From princes down to governors, all were granted perpetual-estate fields, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 多者至一百頃，少者至四十畝。

translations.literal: The most received up to one hundred qing, the least down to forty mu.
translations.idiomatic: The highest received up to one hundred qing, the lowest down to forty mu.

sentences.zh: 其丁男、中男永業露田，皆遵後齊之制。

translations.literal: Adult males' and middling males' perpetual-estate and open fields all followed Later Qi's system.
translations.idiomatic: Adult and middling males' perpetual-estate and open fields all followed Later Qi's system.

sentences.zh: 並課樹以桑榆及棗。

translations.literal: All were assigned to plant mulberry, elm, and jujube.
translations.idiomatic: All were required to plant mulberry, elm, and jujube.

sentences.zh: 其園宅，率三口給一畝，奴婢則五口給一畝。

translations.literal: For gardens and dwellings, generally three persons received one mu; slaves five persons one mu.
translations.idiomatic: For gardens and dwellings, generally three persons received one mu; slaves five persons one mu.

sentences.zh: 丁男一牀，租粟三石。

translations.literal: Adult males per bed paid three shi rent grain.
translations.idiomatic: Adult males per bed paid three shi rent grain.

sentences.zh: 桑土調以絹絁，麻土以布絹。

translations.literal: Mulberry soil paid silk levy; hemp soil paid cloth and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry soil paid silk levy; hemp soil paid cloth and silk.

sentences.zh: 絁以疋，加綿三兩。

translations.literal: Silk by the bolt, plus three liang cotton.
translations.idiomatic: Silk by the bolt, plus three liang of cotton.

sentences.zh: 布以端，加麻三斤。

translations.literal: Cloth by the end, plus three jin hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Cloth by the end, plus three jin of hemp.

sentences.zh: 單丁及僕隸各半之。

translations.literal: Single adult laborers and servants each paid half.
translations.idiomatic: Single adult laborers and servants each paid half.

sentences.zh: 未受地者皆不課。

translations.literal: Those who had not received land paid no levies.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had not received land paid no levies.

sentences.zh: 有品爵及孝子順孫義夫節婦，並免課役。

translations.literal: Those with rank and titles, filial sons, dutiful grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives were all exempt from levies and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Those with rank and titles, filial sons, dutiful grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives were all exempt from levies and corvée.

sentences.zh: 京官又給職分田。

translations.literal: Capital officials were also given functional allotment fields.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials were also given functional allotment fields.

sentences.zh: 一品者給田五頃。

translations.literal: First rank received five qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: First rank received five qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 每品以五十畝為差，至五品，則為田三頃，六品二頃五十畝。

translations.literal: Each rank differed by fifty mu, down to fifth rank three qing; sixth rank two qing fifty mu.
translations.idiomatic: Each rank differed by fifty mu, down to fifth rank three qing; sixth rank two qing fifty mu.

sentences.zh: 其下每品以五十畝為差，至九品為一頃。

translations.literal: Below that each rank differed by fifty mu, down to ninth rank one qing.
translations.idiomatic: Below that each rank differed by fifty mu, down to ninth rank one qing.

sentences.zh: 外官亦各有職分田。

translations.literal: Outer officials also each had functional allotment fields.
translations.idiomatic: Outer officials also each had functional allotment fields.

sentences.zh: 又給公廨田，以供公用。

translations.literal: Also given public office fields for public use.
translations.idiomatic: Public office fields were also granted for public use.

sentences.zh: 開皇三年正月，帝入新宮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Kaihuang, the emperor entered the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 3, first month, the emperor entered the new palace.

sentences.zh: 初令軍人以二十一成丁。

translations.literal: First ordered soldiers to become adult laborers at twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers were first ordered to become adult laborers at twenty-one.

sentences.zh: 減十二番每歲為二十日役，減調絹一疋為二丈。

translations.literal: Reduced twelve rotations to twenty days of corvée per year; reduced silk levy from one bolt to two zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve corvée rotations were reduced to twenty days per year; silk levy was reduced from one bolt to two zhang.

sentences.zh: 先是尚依周末之弊，官置酒坊收利，鹽池鹽井，皆禁百姓採用。

translations.literal: Previously still following Zhou-end abuses, offices set wine monopolies for profit; salt pools and salt wells all forbade common people from using them.
translations.idiomatic: Previously still following Zhou-end abuses, offices set wine monopolies for profit; salt pools and salt wells all forbade common use.

sentences.zh: 至是罷酒坊，通鹽池鹽井與百姓共之。

translations.literal: At this time wine monopolies were abolished; salt pools and salt wells were opened to common people together.
translations.idiomatic: Wine monopolies were abolished; salt pools and salt wells were opened to common use.

sentences.zh: 遠近大悅。

translations.literal: Near and far all rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far all rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 是時突厥犯塞，吐谷渾寇邊，軍旅數起，轉輸勞敝。

translations.literal: At that time the Turks violated the frontier and Tuyuhun raided the border; armies repeatedly rose and transport labor was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Turks violated the frontier and Tuyuhun raided the border; armies rose repeatedly and transport labor was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 帝乃令朔州總管趙仲卿，於長城以北，大興屯田，以實塞下。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Shuo Province Governor Zhao Zhongqing to greatly expand garrison farms north of the Great Wall to fill the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Shuo Province Governor Zhao Zhongqing to greatly expand garrison farms north of the Great Wall to supply the frontier.

sentences.zh: 又於河西，勒百姓立堡，營田積穀。

translations.literal: Also in Hexi ordered common people to establish forts and garrison farms to accumulate grain.
translations.idiomatic: In Hexi common people were ordered to establish forts and garrison farms to accumulate grain.

sentences.zh: 京師置常平監。

translations.literal: In the capital the Ever-Normal Directorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital the Ever-Normal Directorate was established.

sentences.zh: 是時山東尚承齊俗，機巧姦偽，避役惰遊者十六七。

translations.literal: At that time Shandong still inherited Qi customs; the crafty and deceitful, corvée-evaders and idlers, were six or seven in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong still inherited Qi customs; the crafty and idle who evaded corvée were six or seven in ten.

sentences.zh: 四方疲人，或詐老詐小，規免租賦。

translations.literal: Exhausted people from the four directions feigned old age or youth to evade rent and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausted people from all directions feigned old age or youth to evade rent and levies.

sentences.zh: 高祖令州縣大索貌閱，戶口不實者，正長遠配，而又開相糾之科。

translations.literal: Gaozu ordered provinces and counties to conduct a great household inspection; where registration was false, ward chiefs were sent to distant assignment; also opened mutual impeachment statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu ordered provinces and counties to conduct a great household inspection; false registration brought distant assignment for ward chiefs; mutual impeachment statutes were also opened.

sentences.zh: 大功已下，兼令析籍，各為戶頭，以防容隱。

translations.literal: Below great mourning kin, households were also ordered split, each forming separate household heads, to prevent concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Below great-mourning kin, households were also ordered split into separate heads to prevent concealment.

sentences.zh: 於是計帳進四十四萬三千丁，新附一百六十四萬一千五百口。

translations.literal: Thereupon registered accounts advanced four hundred forty-three thousand adult laborers; newly attached one million six hundred forty-one thousand five hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: Registered accounts thereby advanced by 443,000 adult laborers; newly attached persons numbered 1,641,500.

sentences.zh: 高熲又以人間課輸，雖有定分，年常徵納，除注恒多，長吏肆情，文帳出沒，復無定簿，難以推校，乃為輸籍定樣，請徧下諸州。

translations.literal: Gao Jiong also, because among the people levies though had fixed shares, yearly collection always had many extra entries; district officials indulged their feelings, account books appeared and vanished, again with no fixed register, hard to verify—then made a fixed pattern for submission registers and requested dispatch to all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jiong also, because though levies had fixed shares yearly collection always had many extra entries and district officials manipulated accounts with no fixed register, made a fixed pattern for submission registers and requested dispatch to all provinces.

sentences.zh: 每年正月五日，縣令巡人，各隨便近，五黨三黨，共為一團，依樣定戶上下。

translations.literal: Every year on the fifth day of the first month, magistrates inspected people, each according to convenience and proximity; five dang or three dang together formed one group, fixing household upper and lower according to the pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Every year on the fifth day of the first month, magistrates inspected people by neighborhood; five or three dang formed one group, fixing household grades according to the pattern.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this.

sentences.zh: 自是姦無所容矣。

translations.literal: From this fraud had nowhere to hide.
translations.idiomatic: From this fraud had nowhere to hide.

sentences.zh: 時百姓承平日久，雖數遭水旱，而戶口歲增。

translations.literal: At that time common people, having long enjoyed peace, though suffering flood and drought several times, household registration increased yearly.
translations.idiomatic: The people, having long enjoyed peace, though suffering flood and drought several times, saw household registration increase yearly.

sentences.zh: 諸州調物，每歲河南自潼關，河北自蒲坂，達于京師，相屬於路，晝夜不絕者數月。

translations.literal: Provincial tribute goods each year—from Tong Pass in Henan and Puyuan in Hebei, reaching the capital, connected on the road, day and night unceasing for several months.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial tribute each year—from Tong Pass in Henan and Puyuan in Hebei to the capital—filled the roads day and night for months.

sentences.zh: 帝既躬履儉約，六宮咸服澣濯之衣。

translations.literal: The emperor personally practiced frugality; the six palaces all wore washed clothes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally practiced frugality; the six palaces all wore washed clothes.

sentences.zh: 乘輿供御有故敝者，隨令補用，皆不改作。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage and supplies that were worn were patched as needed—all were not remade.
translations.idiomatic: Worn imperial carriage fittings and supplies were patched as needed—nothing was remade.

sentences.zh: 非享燕之事，所食不過一肉而已。

translations.literal: For non-feast affairs, food taken did not exceed one meat dish.
translations.idiomatic: For non-feast affairs, meals did not exceed one meat dish.

sentences.zh: 有司嘗進乾薑，以布袋貯之，帝用為傷費，大加譴責。

translations.literal: Responsible officials once presented dried ginger stored in a cloth bag; the emperor considered it wasteful and greatly reprimanded them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials once presented dried ginger in a cloth bag; the emperor considered it wasteful and reprimanded them severely.

sentences.zh: 後進香，復以氊袋，因笞所司，以為後誡焉。

translations.literal: Later presenting incense again in a felt bag, he flogged the responsible officials as a later warning.
translations.idiomatic: Later incense was again presented in a felt bag; he flogged the responsible officials as a warning.

sentences.zh: 由是內外率職，府帑充實，百官祿賜及賞功臣，皆出於豐厚焉。

translations.literal: From this inner and outer all attended to duty; treasury stores were full; officials' salaries, gifts, and rewards to meritorious ministers all came from abundance.
translations.idiomatic: From this inner and outer offices all attended to duty; treasuries were full; officials' salaries, gifts, and rewards to meritorious ministers all came from abundance.

sentences.zh: 九年陳平，帝親御朱雀門勞凱旋師，[9]因行慶賞。

translations.literal: In the ninth year when Chen was pacified, the emperor personally attended at the [Note: Annals read Guangyang Gate] Vermilion Bird Gate to reward the victorious army, and thereby held celebratory grants.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 when Chen was pacified, the emperor personally attended at the [Note: the Annals read Guangyang Gate] Vermilion Bird Gate to reward the victorious army and held celebratory grants.

sentences.zh: 自門外，夾道列布帛之積，達于南郭，以次頒給。

translations.literal: From outside the gate, cloth and silk piled along the road reaching the southern suburb, distributed in order.
translations.idiomatic: From outside the gate, cloth and silk piled along the road to the southern suburb were distributed in order.

sentences.zh: 所費三百餘萬段。

translations.literal: Expense reached more than three million bolts.
translations.idiomatic: The expense exceeded three million bolts.

sentences.zh: 帝以江表初定，給復十年。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the Jiang region was newly pacified, granted ten years' remission.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Jiang region was newly pacified, the emperor granted ten years' remission.

sentences.zh: 自餘諸州，並免當年租賦。

translations.literal: The remaining provinces all exempted that year's rent and levies.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining provinces all exempted that year's rent and levies.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，又以宇內無事，益寬徭賦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, because within the realm there was no trouble, corvée and levies were further relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10, because the realm was at peace, corvée and levies were further relaxed.

sentences.zh: 百姓年五十者，輸庸停防。

translations.literal: Common people fifty years old paid corvée substitute and stopped frontier guard duty.
translations.idiomatic: Common people aged fifty paid corvée substitute and were exempt from frontier guard duty.

sentences.zh: 十一年，江南又反，越國公楊素討平之，師還，賜物甚廣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Jiangnan rebelled again; Duke of Yue Yang Su suppressed and pacified it; the army returned and gifts were very extensive.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Jiangnan rebelled again; Duke of Yue Yang Su suppressed it; the army returned with extensive rewards.

sentences.zh: 其餘出師命賞，亦莫不優隆。

translations.literal: The remaining expedition orders and rewards were also all generous and lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Other expedition orders and rewards were also generous.

sentences.zh: 十二年，有司上言，庫藏皆滿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year responsible officials memorialized that treasury stores were all full.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 responsible officials reported that treasury stores were all full.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕既薄賦於人，又大經賜用，何得爾也？

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'I have both lightly levied from people and greatly granted and used—how can it be thus?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'I have both lightly taxed the people and greatly granted and spent—how can this be?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「用處常出，納處常入。

translations.literal: ' They replied: 'Expenditure constantly goes out, intake constantly comes in.
translations.idiomatic: ' They replied: 'Expenditure constantly goes out and intake constantly comes in.

sentences.zh: 略計每年賜用，至數百萬段，曾無減損。

translations.literal: Roughly calculating yearly grants and use, reaching several million bolts, never diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Roughly calculated, yearly grants and use reached several million bolts without ever diminishing.

sentences.zh: 」於是乃更闢左藏之院，構屋以受之。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon again opened the Left Treasury courtyard and built rooms to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thereupon the Left Treasury courtyard was opened again and buildings erected to receive the overflow.

sentences.zh: 下詔曰：「既富而教，方知廉恥，寧積於人，無藏府庫。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'When enriched, then teach—then one knows shame and honor; better to accumulate among people than hide in treasury stores.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: 'When the people are enriched, then teach them—then they know shame and honor; better to accumulate among the people than hide in treasury stores.

sentences.zh: 河北、河東今年田租，三分減一，兵減半，功調全免。」

translations.literal: This year's field rent in Hebei and Hedong, reduced one part in three; soldiers halved; labor levies entirely exempted.'
translations.idiomatic: This year's field rent in Hebei and Hedong is reduced by one-third; soldiers halved; labor levies entirely exempted.'

sentences.zh: 時天下戶口歲增，京輔及三河，地少而人眾，衣食不給。

translations.literal: At that time registered population increased yearly; the capital region and Three Rivers had little land and many people; food and clothing were insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Registered population increased yearly; the capital region and Three Rivers had little land and many people; food and clothing were insufficient.

sentences.zh: 議者咸欲徙就寬鄉。

translations.literal: Discussants all wished to migrate to wide districts.
translations.idiomatic: Discussants all wished to migrate people to wide districts.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，帝命諸州考使議之。

translations.literal: That winter the emperor ordered provincial inspection envoys to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the emperor ordered provincial inspection envoys to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 又令尚書，以其事策問四方貢士，竟無長算。

translations.literal: Also ordered the Ministry of Revenue to pose the matter in questions to tribute scholars from the four directions—ultimately no long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue also posed the matter to tribute scholars from all directions—ultimately no long-term plan emerged.

sentences.zh: 帝乃發使四出，均天下之田。

translations.literal: The emperor then sent envoys in four directions to equalize fields throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then sent envoys in four directions to equalize fields throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 其狹鄉，每丁纔至二十畝，老小又少焉。

translations.literal: In narrow districts each adult laborer received only twenty mu; old and young even less.
translations.idiomatic: In narrow districts each adult laborer received only twenty mu; old and young even less.

sentences.zh: 十三年，帝命楊素出，於岐州北造仁壽宮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the emperor ordered Yang Su to go out and build Renshou Palace north of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the emperor ordered Yang Su to build Renshou Palace north of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 素遂夷山堙谷，營構觀宇，崇臺累榭，宛轉相屬。

translations.literal: Su then leveled mountains and filled valleys, constructing halls and towers, lofty terraces and piled pavilions winding and connecting.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Su leveled mountains and filled valleys, constructing halls, lofty terraces, and piled pavilions that wound and connected.

sentences.zh: 役使嚴急，丁夫多死，疲敝顛仆者，推填坑坎，覆以土石，因而築為平地。

translations.literal: Corvée was strict and urgent; many corvée laborers died; the exhausted who collapsed were pushed into pits and covered with earth and stone, then built as level ground.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée was strict and urgent; many laborers died; the exhausted who collapsed were pushed into pits, covered with earth and stone, and built over as level ground.

sentences.zh: 死者以萬數。

translations.literal: The dead numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The dead numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 宮成，帝行幸焉。

translations.literal: When the palace was complete the emperor traveled there.
translations.idiomatic: When the palace was complete the emperor traveled there.

sentences.zh: 時方暑月，而死人相次於道，素乃一切焚除之。

translations.literal: It was midsummer and the dead followed one another on the road; Su then burned them all.
translations.idiomatic: It was midsummer and corpses lined the road; Yang Su then burned them all.

sentences.zh: 帝頗知其事，甚不悅。

translations.literal: The emperor somewhat knew of this matter and was very displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned of this and was deeply displeased.

sentences.zh: 及入新宮遊觀，乃喜，又謂素為忠。

translations.literal: Upon entering the new palace to tour and view, he was then pleased and again considered Su loyal.
translations.idiomatic: Upon entering the new palace to tour and view, he was pleased and again considered Yang Su loyal.

sentences.zh: 後帝以歲暮晚日，登仁壽殿，周望原隰，見宮外燐火彌漫，又聞哭聲。

translations.literal: Later the emperor at year's end on a late day ascended Renshou Hall, looking around the plains and lowlands, saw outside the palace ghost fires spreading, and also heard weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Later at year's end the emperor ascended Renshou Hall, looked around the plains, saw ghost fires spreading outside the palace, and heard weeping.

sentences.zh: 令左右觀之，報曰：「鬼火。

translations.literal: He ordered attendants to observe; they reported: 'Ghost fire.'
translations.idiomatic: He ordered attendants to investigate; they reported: 'Ghost fires.'

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此等工役而死，既屬年暮，魂魄思歸耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'These corvée laborers who died—belonging to year's end, their souls wish to return home?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'These corvée laborers who died—at year's end their souls wish to return home?

sentences.zh: 」乃令灑酒宣敕，以呪遣之。

translations.literal: ' Then ordered wine sprinkled and an edict proclaimed to exorcise and send them away.
translations.idiomatic: ' He ordered wine sprinkled and an edict proclaimed to exorcise and send them away.

sentences.zh: 自是乃息。

translations.literal: From this it then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: After this it ceased.

sentences.zh: 開皇三年，朝廷以京師倉廪尚虛，議為水旱之備，於是詔於蒲、陝、虢、熊、伊、洛、鄭、懷、邵、衞、汴、許、汝等水次十三州，置募運米丁。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaihuang, because capital granaries were still empty, flood and drought reserves were discussed; then an edict at thirteen provinces along water routes—Pu, Shan, Guo, Xiong, Yi, Luo, Zheng, Huai, Shao, Wei, Bian, Xu, Ru and the like—placed corvée laborers to transport rice.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 3, because capital granaries were still empty, flood and drought reserves were discussed; corvée laborers to transport rice were placed at thirteen provinces along water routes.

sentences.zh: 又於衞州置黎陽倉，洛州置河陽倉，陝州置常平倉，華州置廣通倉，轉相灌注。

translations.literal: Also at Weizhou placed Liyang Granary, Luozhou Heyang Granary, Shanzhou Ever-Normal Granary, Huazhou Guangtong Granary—mutually pouring and filling.
translations.idiomatic: Liyang Granary was placed at Weizhou, Heyang at Luozhou, Ever-Normal at Shanzhou, Guangtong at Huazhou—mutually pouring and filling.

sentences.zh: 漕關東及汾、晉之粟，以給京師。

translations.literal: Canal transport of Shandong and Fen-Jin grain to supply the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong and Fen-Jin grain was canal-transported to supply the capital.

sentences.zh: 又遣倉部侍郎韋瓚，向蒲、陝以東，募人能於洛陽運米四十石，經砥柱之險，達于常平者，免其征戍。

translations.literal: Also sent Ministry of Granaries Vice Director Wei Zan east of Pu and Shan to recruit people who could transport forty shi of rice from Luoyang through the Jishi rapids to Ever-Normal and thereby be exempt from frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Granaries Vice Director Wei Zan was sent east of Pu and Shan to recruit people who could transport forty shi of rice from Luoyang through the Jishi rapids to Ever-Normal and be exempt from frontier garrison.

sentences.zh: 其後以渭水多沙，流有深淺，漕者苦之。

translations.literal: Afterward because the Wei River had much sand and flow had deep and shallow parts, canal transporters suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward because the Wei River had much sand and uneven depth, canal transporters suffered.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the fourth year an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict said:

sentences.zh: 京邑所居，五方輻湊，重關四塞，水陸艱難。

translations.literal: The capital's residence, the five directions converge; heavy passes on four sides; land and water difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's residence is where the five directions converge; heavy passes guard four sides; land and water routes are difficult.

sentences.zh: 大河之流，波瀾東注，百川海瀆，萬里交通。

translations.literal: The great river's flow, waves roll east; the hundred streams and sea routes, ten thousand li of communication.
translations.idiomatic: The great river rolls east; the hundred streams and sea routes connect ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 雖三門之下，或有危慮，但發自小平，陸運至陝，還從河水，入於渭川，兼及上流，控引汾、晉，舟車來去，為益殊廣。

translations.literal: Though below Sanmen there may be peril, yet from Xiaoping by land transport to Shan, then returning by river water into the Wei channel, also reaching upper streams, drawing Fen and Jin—boats and carts coming and going, benefit especially broad.
translations.idiomatic: Though below Sanmen there may be peril, yet from Xiaoping by land to Shan, then by river into the Wei, reaching upper streams and drawing on Fen and Jin—boats and carts coming and going bring especially broad benefit.

sentences.zh: 而渭川水力，大小無常，流淺沙深，即成阻閡。

translations.literal: But Wei channel water power, large and small without constancy; shallow flow and deep sand immediately become obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: But Wei channel water power varies without constancy; shallow flow and deep sand immediately become obstruction.

sentences.zh: 計其途路，數百而已，動移氣序，不能往復，汎舟之役，人亦勞止。

translations.literal: Calculating the route, only several hundred li; moving changes season—cannot go and return; the labor of floating boats, people also weary and stop.
translations.idiomatic: The route is only several hundred li; seasons change and boats cannot go and return; floating boats weary the people.

sentences.zh: 朕君臨區宇，興利除害，公私之弊，情實愍之。

translations.literal: I rule the realm, raise benefit and remove harm; public and private abuses, the situation truly moves pity.
translations.idiomatic: I rule the realm, raise benefit and remove harm; public and private abuses truly move pity.

sentences.zh: 故東發潼關，西引渭水，因藉人力，開通漕渠，量事計功，易可成就。

translations.literal: Therefore east from Tong Pass, west drawing Wei water, by human labor opening the canal channel, measuring affairs and calculating labor—easily accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore east from Tong Pass, west drawing Wei water, by human labor opening the canal—easily accomplished.

sentences.zh: 已令工匠，巡歷渠道，觀地理之宜，審終久之義，一得開鑿，萬代無毀。

translations.literal: Already ordered artisans to traverse the channel route, observing terrain's suitability, examining long-term meaning—once opened, ten thousand generations undestroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans have been ordered to traverse the channel, observe terrain, examine long-term meaning—once opened, ten thousand generations undestroyed.

sentences.zh: 可使官及私家。

translations.literal: Can enable officials and private households.
translations.idiomatic: It can serve officials and private households alike.

sentences.zh: 方舟巨舫，晨昏漕運，沿泝不停，旬日之功，堪省億萬。

translations.literal: Great boats and giant ships, morning and evening canal transport, upstream and downstream unceasing—in ten days' labor, saving hundreds of millions.
translations.idiomatic: Great boats and giant ships, morning and evening canal transport, upstream and downstream unceasing—in ten days' labor, saving hundreds of millions.

sentences.zh: 誠知時當炎暑，動致疲勤，然不有暫勞，安能永逸。

translations.literal: Truly knowing the time is hot summer, movement leads to exhaustion—but without temporary labor, how can there be lasting ease?
translations.idiomatic: Truly knowing the season is hot summer and labor brings exhaustion—but without temporary labor, how can there be lasting ease?

sentences.zh: 宣告人庶，知朕意焉。

translations.literal: Proclaim to the people, let them know my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim to the people and let them know my intent.

sentences.zh: 於是命宇文愷率水工鑿渠，引渭水，自大興城東至潼關，三百餘里，名曰廣通渠。

translations.literal: Thereupon ordered Yuwen Kai to lead water engineers to dig a channel, drawing Wei water from east of Daxing city to Tong Pass, more than three hundred li, named Guangtong Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Kai was ordered to lead water engineers to dig a channel drawing Wei water from east of Daxing to Tong Pass, more than three hundred li, named Guangtong Canal.

sentences.zh: 轉運通利，關內賴之。

translations.literal: Canal transport was smooth and convenient; Guanzhong relied on it.
translations.idiomatic: Canal transport was smooth and convenient; Guanzhong relied on it.

sentences.zh: 諸州水旱凶饑之處，亦便開倉賑給。

translations.literal: Provinces with flood, drought, and famine also conveniently opened granaries to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces struck by flood, drought, and famine also opened granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，工部尚書、襄陽縣公長孫平奏曰：「古者三年耕而餘一年之積，九年作而有三年之儲，雖水旱為災，而人無菜色，皆由勸導有方，蓄積先備故也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, Minister of Works and Xiangyang County Duke Sun Changping memorialized: 'Anciently three years' plowing and one year's surplus; nine years' work and three years' stores—though flood and drought were disasters, people had no vegetable color, all because guidance had method and stores were prepared beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 5, Minister of Works Sun Changping memorialized: 'Anciently three years' plowing yielded one year's surplus; nine years' work yielded three years' stores—though flood and drought struck, people did not go hungry, all because guidance was sound and stores prepared beforehand.

sentences.zh: 去年亢陽，關內不熟，陛下哀愍黎元，甚於赤子。

translations.literal: Last year drought scorched; Guanzhong did not ripen; Your Majesty pities the black-haired people more than an infant.
translations.idiomatic: Last year drought scorched Guanzhong; Your Majesty pities the people more than an infant.

sentences.zh: 運山東之粟，置常平之官，開發倉廪，普加賑賜。

translations.literal: Transported Shandong grain, established Ever-Normal offices, opened granaries, universally added relief grants.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong grain was transported, Ever-Normal offices established, granaries opened, and relief universally granted.

sentences.zh: 少食之人，莫不豐足。

translations.literal: People with little food all were full and sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: People with little food were all full and sufficient.

sentences.zh: 鴻恩大德，前古未比。

translations.literal: Vast grace and great virtue, preceding antiquity unmatched.
translations.idiomatic: Vast grace and great virtue unmatched in preceding antiquity.

sentences.zh: 其強宗富室，家道有餘者，皆競出私財，遞相賙贍。

translations.literal: Powerful clans and rich houses with surplus family resources all competed to give private wealth, mutually aiding one another.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful clans and rich houses with surplus resources all competed to give private wealth and aid one another.

sentences.zh: 此乃風行草偃，從化而然。

translations.literal: This is wind moving grass bending, following transformation thus.
translations.idiomatic: This is the wind moving grass—the people following transformation.

sentences.zh: 但經國之理，須存定式。

translations.literal: But governing the state's principle must preserve fixed forms.'
translations.idiomatic: But governing the state requires fixed forms.'

sentences.zh: 」於是奏令諸州百姓及軍人，勸課當社，共立義倉。

translations.literal: Thereupon memorialized ordering common people and soldiers of all provinces to encourage assignment at their she, jointly establishing charity granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he memorialized ordering common people and soldiers of all provinces to encourage assignment at their she and jointly establish charity granaries.

sentences.zh: 收穫之日，隨其所得，勸課出粟及麥，於當社造倉窖貯之。

translations.literal: On harvest days, according to what each obtained, encouraged assignment of millet and wheat; at that she built cellar storage.
translations.idiomatic: On harvest days, according to what each obtained, millet and wheat were encouraged; cellar storage was built at each she.

sentences.zh: 即委社司，執帳檢校，每年收積，勿使損敗。

translations.literal: Entrusted to she officers, keeping accounts and inspection; each year accumulated, do not let spoil.
translations.idiomatic: Entrusted to she officers for accounts and inspection; each year grain was accumulated without spoil.

sentences.zh: 若時或不熟，當社有饑饉者，即以此穀賑給。

translations.literal: If seasons were not ripe, when the she had famine, then used this grain to relieve.
translations.idiomatic: If seasons failed and the she faced famine, this grain was used for relief.

sentences.zh: 自是諸州儲峙委積。

translations.literal: From this all provinces' stores piled up.
translations.idiomatic: From this all provinces' stores piled up.

sentences.zh: 其後關中連年大旱，而青、兗、汴、許、曹、亳、陳、仁、譙、豫、鄭、洛、伊、潁、邳等州大水，百姓饑饉。

translations.literal: Afterward Guanzhong had great drought year after year; Qing, Yan, Bian, Xu, Cao, Bo, Chen, Ren, Qiao, Yu, Zheng, Luo, Yi, Ying, Pi and other provinces had great flood; common people famished.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Guanzhong had drought year after year; Qing, Yan, Bian, Xu, and many other provinces had great flood; the people famished.

sentences.zh: 高祖乃命蘇威等，分道開倉賑給。

translations.literal: Gaozu then ordered Su Wei and others to open granaries in separate routes for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu ordered Su Wei and others to open granaries in separate routes for relief.

sentences.zh: 又命司農丞王亶，發廣通之粟三百餘萬石，以拯關中。

translations.literal: Also ordered Ministry of Agriculture Assistant Director Wang Dan to issue more than three million shi from Guangtong grain to save Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Agriculture Assistant Director Wang Dan was ordered to issue more than three million shi from Guangtong to save Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 又發故城中周代舊粟，賤糶與人。

translations.literal: Also issued old Zhou grain from the old city, sold cheaply to people.
translations.idiomatic: Old Zhou grain from the old city was also issued and sold cheaply to the people.

sentences.zh: 買牛驢六千餘頭，分給尤貧者，令往關東就食。

translations.literal: Purchased six thousand-plus oxen and donkeys, distributed to the extremely poor, ordering them to go to Shandong for food.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand-plus oxen and donkeys were purchased and distributed to the extremely poor, ordering them to go to Shandong for food.

sentences.zh: 其遭水旱之州，皆免其年租賦。

translations.literal: Provinces suffering flood and drought all exempted that year's rent and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces suffering flood and drought all exempted that year's rent and levies.

sentences.zh: 十四年，關中大旱，人飢。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Guanzhong had great drought; people were hungry.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Guanzhong had great drought; people were hungry.

sentences.zh: 上幸洛陽，因令百姓就食。

translations.literal: The emperor traveled to Luoyang and ordered common people to go for food.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor traveled to Luoyang and ordered the people to go for food.

sentences.zh: 從官並准見口賑給，不以官位為限。

translations.literal: Follower officials all granted relief according to registered mouths, not limited by official rank.
translations.idiomatic: Follower officials all received relief according to registered mouths, without rank limit.

sentences.zh: 明年，東巡狩，因祠泰山。

translations.literal: The next year eastern tour and hunt; thereby sacrificing at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: The next year an eastern tour and hunt included sacrifice at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 是時義倉貯在人間，多有費損。

translations.literal: At that time charity granary stores among the people had much waste and loss.
translations.idiomatic: Charity granary stores among the people had much waste and loss.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，詔曰：「本置義倉，止防水旱，百姓之徒，不思久計，輕爾費損，於後乏絕。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year an edict said: 'Originally charity granaries were set only to guard against flood and drought; common people, not thinking of long plans, lightly wasted and damaged—afterward supplies were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 15 an edict said: 'Charity granaries were originally set only against flood and drought; common people, not thinking long-term, lightly wasted them—afterward supplies were exhausted.

sentences.zh: 又北境諸州，異於餘處，雲、夏、長、靈、鹽、蘭、豐、鄯、涼、甘、瓜等州，所有義倉雜種，並納本州。

translations.literal: Also northern frontier provinces differ from the rest; Yun, Xia, Chang, Ling, Yan, Lan, Feng, Shan, Liang, Gan, Gua and other provinces—all charity granary mixed grain delivered to the local province.
translations.idiomatic: Northern frontier provinces also differ; Yun, Xia, Chang, Ling, and other frontier provinces—all charity granary mixed grain was delivered to the local province.

sentences.zh: 若人有旱儉少糧，先給雜種及遠年粟。

translations.literal: If people had drought and shortage of little grain, first gave mixed grain and old-year millet.'
translations.idiomatic: If people faced drought with little grain, mixed grain and old-year millet were given first.'

sentences.zh: 」十六年正月，又詔秦、疊、成、康、武、文、芳、宕、旭、洮、岷、渭、紀、河、廓、豳、隴、涇、寧、原、敷、丹、延、綏、銀、扶等州社倉，並於當縣安置。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year, also ordered she granaries of Qin, Die, Cheng, Kang, Wu, Wen, Fang, Dang, Xu, Tao, Min, Wei, Ji, He, Kuo, Bin, Long, Jing, Ning, Yuan, Fu, Dan, Yan, Sui, Yin, Fu and other provinces all placed in their counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 16, she granaries of Qin, Die, Cheng, and many other frontier provinces were ordered placed in their counties.

sentences.zh: 二月，又詔社倉，准上中下三等稅，上戶不過一石，中戶不過七斗，下戶不過四斗。

translations.literal: In the second month, also ordered she granaries according to upper, middle, and lower three grades of tax: upper households not exceeding one shi, middle not exceeding seven dou, lower not exceeding four dou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month she granaries were ordered taxed in three grades: upper households not exceeding one shi, middle seven dou, lower four dou.

sentences.zh: 其後山東頻年霖雨，杞、宋、陳、亳、曹、戴、譙、潁等諸州，達于滄海，皆困水災，所在沉溺。

translations.literal: Afterward Shandong year after year had continuous rain; Qi, Song, Chen, Bo, Cao, Dai, Qiao, Ying and other provinces reaching the sea all suffered flood disaster, everywhere submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Shandong had continuous rain year after year; Qi, Song, Chen, and other provinces reaching the sea all suffered flood and were submerged.

sentences.zh: 十八年，天子遣使，將水工，巡行川源，相視高下，發隨近丁以疏導之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Son of Heaven sent envoys with water engineers to traverse river sources, observing high and low, mobilizing nearby corvée laborers to dredge.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the emperor sent envoys with water engineers to traverse river sources, observe terrain, and mobilize nearby corvée laborers to dredge.

sentences.zh: 困乏者，開倉賑給，前後用穀五百餘石。

translations.literal: The exhausted opened granaries for relief; before and after used more than five hundred shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The exhausted received granary relief; before and after more than five hundred shi of grain was used.

sentences.zh: [10]遭水之處，租調皆免。

translations.literal: [Note: text likely missing '萬' (ten thousand); should read five million-plus shi] Where flood was encountered, rent and levies were all exempted.
translations.idiomatic: [Note: text likely missing 'ten thousand'; should read five million-plus shi] Where flood was encountered, rent and levies were all exempted.

sentences.zh: 自是頻有年矣。

translations.literal: From this there were frequent good years.
translations.idiomatic: From this good harvests were frequent.

sentences.zh: 開皇八年五月，高熲奏諸州無課調處，及課州管戶數少者，官人祿力，乘前已來，恒出隨近之州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year of Kaihuang, Gao Jiong memorialized that provinces without levy districts and levy provinces with few registered households—officials' salary labor, from before until now, constantly came from nearby provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 8, fifth month, Gao Jiong memorialized that provinces without levy districts and levy provinces with few registered households—officials' salary labor constantly came from nearby provinces.

sentences.zh: 但判官本為牧人，役力理出所部。

translations.literal: But judging officials were originally to shepherd people; corvée labor should come from their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: But magistrates were originally to shepherd people; corvée labor should come from their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 請於所管戶內，計戶徵稅。

translations.literal: Requested within governed households to calculate households and collect tax.
translations.idiomatic: He requested tax calculated by households within each jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved this.

sentences.zh: 先是京官及諸州，並給公廨錢，廻易生利，以給公用。

translations.literal: Previously capital officials and all provinces all received public office money, revolving trade for profit to supply public use.
translations.idiomatic: Previously capital officials and all provinces received public office money, revolving trade for profit to supply public use.

sentences.zh: 至十四年六月，工部尚書、安平郡公蘇孝慈等，以為所在官司，因循往昔，以公廨錢物，出舉興生，唯利是求，煩擾百姓，敗損風俗，莫斯之甚。

translations.literal: To the sixth month of the fourteenth year, Minister of Works and Anping County Duke Su Xiaoci and others considered that local offices, following the past, used public office money and goods for lending and profit-seeking, only seeking benefit, troubling common people, damaging customs—nothing exceeds this.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourteenth year's sixth month, Minister of Works Su Xiaoci and others considered that local offices, following past practice, used public office money for lending and profit, troubling the people and damaging customs—nothing exceeded this.

sentences.zh: 於是奏皆給地以營農，廻易取利，一皆禁止。

translations.literal: Thereupon memorialized all to be given land for farming agriculture; revolving trade for profit—all prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: They memorialized that all should be given land for farming; revolving trade for profit was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 十七年十一月，詔在京及在外諸司公廨，在市廻易，及諸處興生，並聽之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year an edict permitted capital and outer offices' public offices to trade in markets and all places to raise profit—all permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year's eleventh month an edict permitted capital and outer offices' public offices to trade in markets—all permitted.

sentences.zh: 唯禁出舉收利云。

translations.literal: Only lending for profit was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Only lending for profit was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 煬帝即位，是時戶口益多，府庫盈溢，乃除婦人及奴婢部曲之課。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang succeeded, at that time registered population increasingly many, treasury stores overflowing; then removed levies on women and slave retainers and private troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang succeeded, registered population grew and treasuries overflowed; levies on women, slave retainers, and private troops were removed.

sentences.zh: 男子以二十二成丁。

translations.literal: Males became adult laborers at twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: Males became adult laborers at twenty-two.

sentences.zh: 始建東都，以尚書令楊素為營作大監，每月役丁二百萬人。

translations.literal: First built the Eastern Capital; Minister Over the Masses Yang Su was construction grand supervisor; each month two million corvée laborers.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital was first built; Minister Over the Masses Yang Su served as construction grand supervisor with two million corvée laborers each month.

sentences.zh: 徙洛州郭內人及天下諸州富商大賈數萬家，以實之。

translations.literal: Moved people within Luozhou city walls and wealthy merchants of all provinces numbering tens of thousands of households to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: People within Luozhou and wealthy merchants from all provinces numbering tens of thousands of households were moved to fill it.

sentences.zh: 新置興洛及廻洛倉。

translations.literal: Newly established Xingluo and Huiluo granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Xingluo and Huiluo granaries were newly established.

sentences.zh: 又於皁澗營顯仁宮，苑囿連接，北至新安，南及飛山，西至澠池，周圍數百里。

translations.literal: Also at Zaojian built Xianren Palace; parks and preserves connected, north reaching Xin'an, south reaching Fei Mountain, west reaching Mianchi, circumference several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Xianren Palace was also built at Zaojian; parks connected north to Xin'an, south to Fei Mountain, west to Mianchi, circumference several hundred li.

sentences.zh: 課天下諸州，各貢草木花果，奇禽異獸於其中。

translations.literal: Ordered all provinces of the realm each to tribute grasses, trees, flowers, fruits, rare birds and strange beasts therein.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces were ordered to tribute grasses, trees, flowers, fruits, rare birds, and strange beasts therein.

sentences.zh: 開渠，引穀、洛水，自苑西入，而東注于洛。

translations.literal: Opened a channel, drawing Gu and Luo water from west of the park east into the Luo.
translations.idiomatic: A channel was opened drawing Gu and Luo water from west of the park east into the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 又自板渚引河，達于淮海，謂之御河。

translations.literal: Also from Banzhu drew the Yellow River, reaching Huaihai, called the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River was also drawn from Banzhu to Huaihai, called the Imperial Canal.

sentences.zh: 河畔築御道，樹以柳。

translations.literal: Along the river bank an imperial road was built, planted with willows.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial road was built along the riverbank, planted with willows.

sentences.zh: 又命黃門侍郎王弘、上儀同於士澄，往江南諸州採大木，引至東都。

translations.literal: Also ordered Yellow Gate Vice Director Wang Hong and Upper Palace Companion Yu Shicheng to go to Jiangnan provinces to collect great timber and transport to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Gate Vice Director Wang Hong and Upper Palace Companion Yu Shicheng were ordered to Jiangnan provinces to collect great timber for the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 所經州縣，遞送往返，首尾相屬，不絕者千里。

translations.literal: Provinces and counties passed along on the return journey, head and tail connecting, unceasing for a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces and counties relayed timber on the return journey, connecting head to tail unceasing for a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 而東都役使促迫，僵仆而斃者，十四五焉。

translations.literal: But Eastern Capital corvée was urgent; those who collapsed and died were fourteen or fifteen in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital corvée was urgent; those who collapsed and died were four or five in ten.

sentences.zh: 每月載死丁，東至城臯，北至河陽，車相望於道。

translations.literal: Each month dead corvée laborers, east reaching Chenggao, north reaching Heyang, carts connected on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Each month carts carrying dead corvée laborers stretched from Chenggao in the east to Heyang in the north.

sentences.zh: 時帝將事遼、碣，增置軍府，掃地為兵。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was about to campaign in Liao and Jie; military offices were increased; sweeping the ground for soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to campaign in Liaodong; military offices were increased and soldiers conscripted from every household.

sentences.zh: 自是租賦之入益減矣。

translations.literal: From this rent and levy intake increasingly diminished.
translations.idiomatic: From this rent and levy revenue increasingly diminished.

sentences.zh: 又造龍舟鳳䑽，黃龍赤艦，樓船篾舫。

translations.literal: Also built dragon boats and phoenix barges, yellow dragon and red warships, tower ships and bamboo rafts.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon boats and phoenix barges, yellow dragon and red warships, tower ships and bamboo rafts were also built.

sentences.zh: 募諸水工，謂之殿脚，衣錦行幐，執青絲纜挽船，以幸江都。

translations.literal: Recruited various water engineers called 'palace feet,' wearing brocade leggings, holding green silk cables to tow boats, to travel to Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Water engineers were recruited as 'palace feet,' wearing brocade leggings and holding green silk cables to tow boats to Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 帝御龍舟，文武官五品已上給樓船，九品已上給黃篾舫，舳艫相接，二百餘里。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the dragon boat; civil and military officials fifth rank and above received tower ships, ninth rank and above yellow bamboo rafts; ships connected for more than two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode the dragon boat; civil and military officials fifth rank and above received tower ships, ninth rank and above yellow bamboo rafts; ships connected for more than two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 所經州縣，並令供頓，獻食豐辦者，加官爵，闕乏者，譴至死。

translations.literal: Provinces and counties passed through were all ordered to supply stations; those presenting abundant food were promoted in rank and title, those deficient were condemned to death.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces and counties passed through were ordered to supply stations; those presenting abundant food were promoted, those deficient were condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 又盛修車輿輦輅，旌旗羽儀之飾。

translations.literal: Also greatly repaired chariots, palanquins, and imperial carriages, banners, flags, feather insignia, and adornments.
translations.idiomatic: Chariots, palanquins, imperial carriages, banners, flags, and feather insignia were also greatly repaired.

sentences.zh: 課天下州縣，凡骨角齒牙，皮革毛羽，可飾器用，堪為氅毦者，皆責焉。

translations.literal: Ordered all provinces and counties of the realm: all bone, horn, tooth, tusk, leather, feather, and fur usable for ornamenting implements and suitable for cloaks and blankets—all were levied.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces and counties were ordered to levy bone, horn, tooth, tusk, leather, feather, and fur usable for ornaments and cloaks.

sentences.zh: 徵發倉卒，朝命夕辦，百姓求捕，網罟徧野，水陸禽獸殆盡，猶不能給，而買於豪富蓄積之家，其價騰踊。

translations.literal: Mobilization was hasty; morning orders evening completion; common people sought capture; nets and traps filled the wilds; water and land birds and beasts nearly exhausted, still insufficient—then bought from rich houses with accumulated stores at soaring prices.
translations.idiomatic: Mobilization was hasty; morning orders demanded evening completion; people hunted until water and land birds and beasts were nearly exhausted—still insufficient, and purchases from rich hoarders at soaring prices followed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，翟雉尾一，直十縑，白鷺鮮半之。

translations.literal: That year one pheasant tail was worth ten bolts of silk; half a white egret.
translations.idiomatic: That year one pheasant tail was worth ten bolts of silk; half that for a white egret.

sentences.zh: 乃使屯田主事常駿使赤土國，致羅剎。

translations.literal: Then sent Garrison Farm Supervisor Chang Jun as envoy to Chitu Kingdom to obtain rakshasa.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Farm Supervisor Chang Jun was sent as envoy to Chitu Kingdom to obtain rakshasa.

sentences.zh: 又使朝請大夫張鎮州擊流求，俘虜數萬。

translations.literal: Also sent Court Gentleman Zhang Zhenzhou to attack Liuqiu and capture tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Court Gentleman Zhang Zhenzhou was also sent to attack Liuqiu and capture tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 士卒深入，蒙犯瘴癘，餒疾而死者十八九。

translations.literal: Soldiers went deep, braving miasma; hunger and disease caused eight or nine in ten to die.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers went deep, braving miasma; hunger and disease killed eight or nine in ten.

sentences.zh: 又以西域多諸寶物，令裴矩往張掖，監諸商胡互市。

translations.literal: Also because the Western Regions had many precious things, ordered Pei Ju to go to Zhangye to supervise mutual trade among merchant Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Western Regions had many precious goods, Pei Ju was ordered to Zhangye to supervise mutual trade among merchant Hu.

sentences.zh: 啖之以利，勸令入朝。

translations.literal: Tempted them with profit, encouraged them to enter court.
translations.idiomatic: They were tempted with profit and encouraged to enter court.

sentences.zh: 自是西域諸蕃，往來相繼，所經州郡，疲於送迎，縻費以萬萬計。

translations.literal: From this Western Region various fan came and went in succession; provinces and counties passed through were exhausted by escort; expenses numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Western Region peoples came and went in succession; provinces and counties passed through were exhausted by escort at expense numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 明年，帝北巡狩。

translations.literal: The next year the emperor toured north.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the emperor toured north.

sentences.zh: 又興眾百萬，北築長城，西距榆林，東至紫河，緜亘千餘里，死者太半。

translations.literal: Also raised a million masses to build the Great Wall north, west from Yulin, east to Zi River, continuous more than a thousand li; more than half died.
translations.idiomatic: A million masses were also raised to build the Great Wall north, west from Yulin to Zi River, more than a thousand li continuous; more than half died.

sentences.zh: 四年，發河北諸郡百餘萬眾，引沁水，南達于河，北通涿郡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year mobilized more than a million masses from Hebei commanderies, drawing Qin water south reaching the river, north connecting to Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 more than a million masses from Hebei commanderies were mobilized to draw Qin water south to the river and north to Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 自是以丁男不供，始以婦人從役。

translations.literal: From this adult males were insufficient; then women were first used for corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Adult males were insufficient; women were first used for corvée.

sentences.zh: 五年，西巡河右。

translations.literal: In the fifth year western tour of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 a western tour of Hexi was held.

sentences.zh: 西域諸胡，佩金玉，被錦罽，焚香奏樂，迎候道左。

translations.literal: Various Hu of the Western Regions, wearing gold and jade, draped in brocade rugs, burning incense and playing music, waited at the road's left.
translations.idiomatic: Various Hu of the Western Regions, wearing gold and jade, draped in brocade rugs, burning incense and playing music, waited at the roadside.

sentences.zh: 帝乃令武威、張掖士女，盛飾縱觀。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Wuwei and Zhangye men and women to dress splendidly and watch freely.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Wuwei and Zhangye men and women to dress splendidly and watch freely.

sentences.zh: 衣服車馬不鮮者，州縣督課，以誇示之。

translations.literal: Those with unstylish clothes and horses—provinces and counties supervised and taxed to display them.
translations.idiomatic: Those with unstylish clothes and horses were supervised and taxed by provinces and counties for display.

sentences.zh: 其年，帝親征吐谷渾，破之於赤水。

translations.literal: That year the emperor personally campaigned against Tuyuhun and defeated them at Chishui.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor personally campaigned against Tuyuhun and defeated them at Chishui.

sentences.zh: 慕容佛允，[11]委其家屬，西奔青海。

translations.literal: Murong Fuyun, [Note: Tuyuhun Annals read '伏' for '佛'] abandoned his family and fled west to Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Fuyun—[Note: the Tuyuhun Annals read a different character for the second syllable]—abandoned his family and fled west to Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 帝駐兵不出，遇天霖雨，經大斗拔谷，士卒死者十二三焉，馬驢十八九。

translations.literal: The emperor stationed troops without advancing; encountering heaven's heavy rain, passing through Dadouba Valley, soldiers who died were twelve or thirteen in ten; horses and donkeys eighteen or nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stationed troops without advancing; encountering heavy rain and passing through Dadouba Valley, twelve or thirteen soldiers in ten died; eighteen or nineteen horses and donkeys in ten.

sentences.zh: 於是置河源郡、積石鎮。

translations.literal: Thereupon established Heyuan Commandery and Jishi Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Heyuan Commandery and Jishi Garrison were established.

sentences.zh: 又於西域之地，置西海、鄯善、且末等郡。

translations.literal: Also in Western Region lands established Xihai, Shanshan, Qimo and other commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In Western Region lands Xihai, Shanshan, Qimo, and other commanderies were established.

sentences.zh: 讁天下罪人，配為戍卒，大開屯田，發西方諸郡運糧以給之。

translations.literal: Condemned criminals of the realm were assigned as garrison soldiers; greatly opened garrison farms; mobilized western commanderies to transport grain to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Criminals of the realm were assigned as garrison soldiers; garrison farms were greatly opened; western commanderies were mobilized to transport grain.

sentences.zh: 道里懸遠，兼遇寇抄，死亡相續。

translations.literal: Roads were distant; also encountering bandit raids; death followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Roads were distant and bandit raids frequent; deaths followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 六年，將征高麗，有司奏兵馬已多損耗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, about to campaign against Goguryeo, responsible officials memorialized that soldiers and horses had much wastage.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, about to campaign against Goguryeo, officials reported much wastage of soldiers and horses.

sentences.zh: 詔又課天下富人，量其貲產，出錢市武馬，填元數。

translations.literal: An edict again assessed wealthy people of the realm, measuring their property, paying money to buy war horses to fill the original number.
translations.idiomatic: An edict again assessed wealthy people, measuring property to pay for war horses to fill the original number.

sentences.zh: 限令取足。

translations.literal: Limited time to obtain full amount.
translations.idiomatic: A deadline was set to obtain the full amount.

sentences.zh: 復點兵具器仗，皆令精新，濫惡則使人便斬。

translations.literal: Again inspected soldiers' equipment and weapons—all ordered refined and new; shoddy ones caused the responsible person to be immediately beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers' equipment and weapons were again inspected—all ordered refined and new; shoddy ones caused immediate beheading of the responsible person.

sentences.zh: 於是馬匹至十萬。

translations.literal: Thereupon war horses reached one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: War horses thereby reached one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，大會涿郡。

translations.literal: Seventh year winter, great assembly at Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Winter of year 7, great assembly at Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 分江淮南兵，配驍衞大將軍來護兒，別以舟師濟滄海，舳艫數百里。

translations.literal: Divided Jiang-Huai southern soldiers, assigning Brave Guard Grand General Lai Hu'er; separately with naval forces crossed Canghai; ships connected for several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai southern soldiers were divided, assigning Brave Guard Grand General Lai Hu'er; separately naval forces crossed the sea; ships connected for several hundred li.

sentences.zh: 並載軍糧，期與大兵會平壤。

translations.literal: All carried army grain, scheduled to meet the great army at Pyongyang.
translations.idiomatic: All carried army grain, scheduled to meet the great army at Pyongyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲山東、河南大水，漂沒四十餘郡，重以遼東覆敗，死者數十萬。

translations.literal: That year Shandong and Henan had great flood, drowning more than forty commanderies; added to Liaodong defeat, dead numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shandong and Henan had great flood drowning more than forty commanderies; added to Liaodong defeat, dead numbered in the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 因屬疫疾，山東尤甚。

translations.literal: Then epidemic disease followed; Shandong was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Epidemic disease followed; Shandong was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 所在皆以徵斂供帳軍旅所資為務，百姓雖困，而弗之恤也。

translations.literal: Everywhere took exactions and collections supplying army travel expenses as the task; though common people were distressed, they were not pitied.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere exactions supplying army travel expenses were the priority; though the people were distressed, they were not pitied.

sentences.zh: 每急徭卒賦，有所徵求，長吏必先賤買之，然後宣下，乃貴賣與人，旦暮之間，價盈數倍，裒刻徵斂，取辦一時。

translations.literal: Whenever urgent corvée and levies had requisitions, district officials first bought cheaply, then announced downward, then sold expensively to people; between morning and evening prices multiplied several times; squeezing and collecting, completed in one time.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever urgent corvée and levies were requisitioned, district officials first bought cheaply, then announced the order, then sold expensively to the people; between morning and evening prices multiplied several times.

sentences.zh: 強者聚而為盜，弱者自賣為奴婢。

translations.literal: The strong gathered and became bandits; the weak sold themselves as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: The strong gathered as bandits; the weak sold themselves as slaves.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔又課關中富人，計其貲產出驢，往伊吾、河源、且末運糧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict again assessed wealthy people of Guanzhong, calculating property to produce donkeys, going to Yiwu, Heyuan, Qimo to transport grain.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 an edict again assessed wealthy Guanzhong people, calculating property to produce donkeys for grain transport to Yiwu, Heyuan, and Qimo.

sentences.zh: 多者至數百頭，每頭價至萬餘。

translations.literal: Those with many reached several hundred head; each head's price reached more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Those with many reached several hundred head; each head's price exceeded ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 又發諸州丁，分為四番，於遼西柳城營屯，往來艱苦，生業盡罄。

translations.literal: Also mobilized corvée laborers of all provinces, divided into four rotations, garrison farming at Liucheng in Liaoxi; going and returning arduous, livelihood entirely exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée laborers of all provinces were mobilized in four rotations for garrison farming at Liucheng in Liaoxi; travel was arduous and livelihoods exhausted.

sentences.zh: 盜賊四起，道路南絕，隴右牧馬，盡為奴賊所掠，楊玄感乘虛為亂。

translations.literal: Banditry rose everywhere; roads to the south cut off; Longyou pasture horses all plundered by slave bandits; Yang Xuan'gan seized the opportunity to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Banditry rose everywhere; southern roads were cut; Longyou pasture horses were plundered by slave bandits; Yang Xuan'gan seized the opportunity to rebel.

sentences.zh: 時帝在遼東，聞之，遽歸于高陽郡。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor was in Liaodong; hearing this, hurriedly returned to Gaoyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was in Liaodong; hearing this, he hurriedly returned to Gaoyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及玄感平，帝謂侍臣曰：「玄感一呼而從者如市，益知天下人不欲多，多則為賊。

translations.literal: When Xuan'gan was pacified the emperor told attendant ministers: 'Xuan'gan one call and followers like a market—more know people of the realm do not wish many; many then become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuan'gan was pacified the emperor told ministers: 'Xuan'gan one call and followers like a market—I know the people do not wish to be many; too many and they become bandits.

sentences.zh: 不盡誅，後無以示勸。

translations.literal: Not entirely executing, afterward no means to show encouragement.'
translations.idiomatic: If not entirely executed, afterward there is no means to show encouragement.'

sentences.zh: 」乃令裴蘊窮其黨與，詔郡縣坑殺之，死者不可勝數。

translations.literal: Then ordered Pei Yun to exhaust his faction; edict to commanderies and counties to pit and kill them; dead beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yun was ordered to exhaust Xuan'gan's faction; commanderies and counties were edicted to pit and kill them; dead beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 所在驚駭。

translations.literal: Everywhere alarmed and terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere people were alarmed and terrified.

sentences.zh: 舉天下之人十分，九為盜賊，皆盜武馬，始作長槍，攻陷城邑。

translations.literal: Of all people under heaven ten parts, nine were bandits; all stole war horses, first made long spears, attacked and seized cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: Of all people under heaven nine in ten were bandits; all stole war horses, made long spears, and attacked cities and towns.

sentences.zh: 帝又命郡縣置督捕以討賊。

translations.literal: The emperor again ordered commanderies and counties to place supervisors to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again ordered commanderies and counties to place supervisors to suppress bandits.

sentences.zh: 益遣募人征遼，馬少不充八馱，而許為六馱。

translations.literal: Further sent recruiters for Liaodong campaign; horses few, not filling eight pack animals—then permitted six pack animals.
translations.idiomatic: Further recruiters were sent for the Liaodong campaign; horses were few and did not fill eight pack animals—six were permitted.

sentences.zh: 又不足，聽半以驢充。

translations.literal: Again insufficient—permitted half filled with donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: Again insufficient—half filling with donkeys was permitted.

sentences.zh: 在路逃者相繼，執獲皆斬之，而莫能止。

translations.literal: Those who fled on the road followed in succession; captured all beheaded—and could not stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Fugitives on the road followed in succession; captured fugitives were beheaded—and still it could not be stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝不懌。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 遇高麗執送叛臣斛斯政，遣使求降，發詔赦之。

translations.literal: Encountering Goguryeo escorting and delivering the rebel minister Husizheng, sent envoys seeking surrender, issued edict pardoning them.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo escorted rebel minister Husizheng; envoys sought surrender and an edict pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 囚政至于京師，於開遠門外，磔而射殺之。

translations.literal: Prisoner Zheng reached the capital; outside Kaiyuan Gate dismembered and shot to death.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was brought to the capital; outside Kaiyuan Gate he was dismembered and shot to death.

sentences.zh: 遂幸太原，為突厥圍於雁門。

translations.literal: Then traveled to Taiyuan; besieged by Turks at Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Then he traveled to Taiyuan; Turks besieged him at Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 突厥尋散，遽還洛陽，募益驍果，以充舊數。

translations.literal: Turks soon dispersed; hurriedly returned to Luoyang; recruited more elite soldiers to fill the old number.
translations.idiomatic: Turks soon dispersed; he hurriedly returned to Luoyang and recruited elite soldiers to fill the old number.

sentences.zh: 是時百姓廢業，屯集城堡，無以自給。

translations.literal: At that time common people abandoned occupations, gathered in castles, unable to support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: People abandoned occupations, gathered in castles, unable to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 然所在倉庫，猶大充牣，吏皆懼法，莫肯賑救，由是益困。

translations.literal: Yet everywhere granaries still greatly full; officials all feared the law, none willing to grant relief—thereby increasingly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet granaries everywhere were still full; officials feared the law and none granted relief—the people grew ever more distressed.

sentences.zh: 初皆剝樹皮以食之，漸及於葉，皮葉皆盡，乃煮土或擣藳為末而食之。

translations.literal: At first all stripped tree bark to eat; gradually reaching leaves; bark and leaves all exhausted—then boiled earth or pounded straw into powder to eat.
translations.idiomatic: At first all stripped tree bark to eat; gradually leaves; bark and leaves exhausted—then boiled earth or pounded straw into powder to eat.

sentences.zh: 其後人乃相食。

translations.literal: Afterward people then ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 十二年，帝幸江都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor traveled to Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the emperor traveled to Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 是時李密據洛口倉，聚眾百萬。

translations.literal: At that time Li Mi held Luokou Granary; gathered masses of a million.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi held Luokou Granary and gathered masses of a million.

sentences.zh: 越王侗與段達等守東都。

translations.literal: Prince of Yue Tong and Duan Da and others guarded the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yue Yang Tong and Duan Da and others guarded the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 東都城內糧盡，布帛山積，乃以絹為汲綆，然布以爨。

translations.literal: Within the Eastern Capital city grain was exhausted; cloth and silk piled like mountains—then used silk for well ropes, burned cloth for cooking.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Eastern Capital grain was exhausted; cloth and silk piled like mountains—silk was used for well ropes and cloth burned for cooking.

sentences.zh: 代王侑與衞玄守京師，百姓饑饉，亦不能救。

translations.literal: Prince Dai You and Wei Xuan guarded the capital; common people famished, also could not save.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dai Yang You and Wei Xuan guarded the capital; the people famished and could not be saved.

sentences.zh: 義師入長安，發永豐倉以賑之，百姓方蘇息矣。

translations.literal: The righteous army entered Chang'an; opened Yongfeng Granary to relieve them; common people then revived.
translations.idiomatic: The righteous army entered Chang'an, opened Yongfeng Granary to relieve them, and the people revived.

sentences.zh: 晉自過江，凡貨賣奴婢馬牛田宅，有文券，率錢一萬，輸估四百入官，賣者三百，買者一百。

translations.literal: From Jin after crossing the river, all buying and selling of slaves, horses, oxen, fields, and dwellings had written contracts; generally ten thousand cash, four hundred cash appraisal tax entered office; seller three hundred, buyer one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin crossed the river, all sales of slaves, horses, oxen, fields, and dwellings had written contracts; generally of ten thousand cash, four hundred cash appraisal tax entered office; seller three hundred, buyer one hundred.

sentences.zh: 無文券者，隨物所堪，亦百分收四，名為散估。

translations.literal: Without written contracts, according to what goods could bear, also four percent collected—called scattered appraisal.
translations.idiomatic: Without written contracts, according to goods' value, four percent was also collected—called scattered appraisal.

sentences.zh: 歷宋齊梁陳，如此以為常。

translations.literal: Through Song, Qi, Liang, Chen, thus as constant.
translations.idiomatic: Through Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen, this remained constant.

sentences.zh: 以此人競商販，不為田業，故使均輸，欲為懲勵。

translations.literal: Using this people competed in commerce, not doing field occupations; therefore wished equal transport as punishment and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this people competed in commerce rather than farming; equal transport was intended as punishment and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 雖以此為辭，其實利在侵削。

translations.literal: Though using this as pretext, the real profit lay in encroachment and reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Though this was the pretext, the real profit lay in encroachment and reduction.

sentences.zh: 又都西有石頭津，東有方山津，各置津主一人，賊曹一人，直水五人，以檢察禁物及亡叛者。

translations.literal: Also west of the capital was Shitou Ford, east was Fangshan Ford; each placed a ford chief, one bandit-catcher, five water guards—to inspect prohibited goods and fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: West of the capital was Shitou Ford, east Fangshan Ford; each had a ford chief, one bandit-catcher, and five water guards to inspect prohibited goods and fugitives.

sentences.zh: 其荻炭魚薪之類過津者，並十分稅一以入官。

translations.literal: Reed, charcoal, fish, and firewood passing the ford—all one part in ten tax entered office.
translations.idiomatic: Reed, charcoal, fish, and firewood passing the ford paid one part in ten tax to office.

sentences.zh: 其東路無禁貨，故方山津檢察甚簡。

translations.literal: The eastern route had no prohibited goods; therefore Fangshan Ford inspection was very simple.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern route had no prohibited goods; Fangshan Ford inspection was therefore very light.

sentences.zh: 淮水北有大市百餘，小市十餘所。

translations.literal: North of the Huai River were more than a hundred great markets, more than ten small markets.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Huai were more than a hundred great markets and more than ten small markets.

sentences.zh: 大市備置官司，稅斂既重，時甚苦之。

translations.literal: Great markets fully placed official offices; tax collection was heavy; at the time very bitter.
translations.idiomatic: Great markets had full official offices; tax collection was heavy and deeply resented.

sentences.zh: 梁初，唯京師及三吳、荊、郢、江、湘、梁、益用錢。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Liang, only the capital and Three Wu, Jing, Ying, Jiang, Xiang, Liang, Yi used coin.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Liang, only the capital and Three Wu, Jing, Ying, Jiang, Xiang, Liang, and Yi used coin.

sentences.zh: 其餘州郡，則雜以穀帛交易。

translations.literal: The remaining provinces and commanderies then mixed grain and cloth for trade.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining provinces and commanderies mixed grain and cloth for trade.

sentences.zh: 交、廣之域，全以金銀為貨。

translations.literal: Jiao and Guang regions entirely used gold and silver as currency.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao and Guang regions entirely used gold and silver as currency.

sentences.zh: 武帝乃鑄錢，肉好周郭，文曰「五銖」，重如其文。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu then cast coin, rim and hole complete, inscription 'Five Zhu,' weight matching inscription.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu cast coin with complete rim and hole, inscribed 'Five Zhu,' weight matching inscription.

sentences.zh: 而又別鑄，除其肉郭，謂之女錢。

translations.literal: Also separately cast, removing the rim—called female coin.
translations.idiomatic: He also separately cast coins without the rim—called female coin.

sentences.zh: 二品並行。

translations.literal: Both types circulated together.
translations.idiomatic: Both types circulated together.

sentences.zh: 百姓或私以古錢交易，有直百五銖、五銖、女錢、太平百錢、定平一百、五銖雉錢、五銖對文等號。

translations.literal: Common people sometimes privately used ancient coin for trade: Zhibai Wuzhu, Wuzhu, female coin, Taiping Hundred Coin, Dingping Hundred, Wuzhu Pheasant Coin, Wuzhu Paired Inscription and other names.
translations.idiomatic: People sometimes privately used ancient coin: Zhibai Wuzhu, Wuzhu, female coin, Taiping Hundred Coin, Dingping Hundred, Wuzhu Pheasant Coin, Wuzhu Paired Inscription, and other types.

sentences.zh: 輕重不一。

translations.literal: Light and heavy not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Weight was not uniform.

sentences.zh: 天子頻下詔書，非新鑄二種之錢，並不許用。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven repeatedly issued edicts: except the two newly cast types, all not permitted for use.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly issued edicts: except the two newly cast types, all others were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 而趣利之徒，私用轉甚。

translations.literal: But profit-seekers privately used them increasingly.
translations.idiomatic: But profit-seekers used them privately ever more.

sentences.zh: 至普通中，乃議盡罷銅錢，更鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: By the Putong period, then discussed entirely abolishing copper coin, newly casting iron coin.
translations.idiomatic: By the Putong period it was proposed to abolish copper coin entirely and cast iron coin instead.

sentences.zh: 人以鐵賤易得，並皆私鑄。

translations.literal: People because iron was cheap easily obtained—all privately cast.
translations.idiomatic: Because iron was cheap and easily obtained, all privately cast coin.

sentences.zh: 及大同已後，所在鐵錢，遂如丘山，物價騰貴。

translations.literal: By Datong afterward, everywhere iron coin then like hills; goods' prices soared.
translations.idiomatic: By the Datong period iron coin piled like hills everywhere and prices soared.

sentences.zh: 交易者以車載錢，不復計數，而唯論貫。

translations.literal: Traders loaded coin by cart, no longer counting—only discussing strings.
translations.idiomatic: Traders loaded coin by cart, no longer counting individual pieces—only discussing strings.

sentences.zh: 商旅姦詐，因之以求利。

translations.literal: Traveling merchants crafty and deceitful, thereby seeking profit.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling merchants grew crafty and deceitful, seeking profit thereby.

sentences.zh: 自破嶺以東，八十為百，名曰東錢。

translations.literal: East of Poling, eighty counted as a hundred—called Eastern Coin.
translations.idiomatic: East of Poling, eighty counted as a hundred—called Eastern Coin.

sentences.zh: 江、郢已上，七十為百，名曰西錢。

translations.literal: Jiang and Ying and above, seventy as a hundred—called Western Coin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Ying and above, seventy as a hundred—called Western Coin.

sentences.zh: 京師以九十為百，名曰長錢。

translations.literal: The capital with ninety as a hundred—called Long Coin.
translations.idiomatic: The capital with ninety as a hundred—called Long Coin.

sentences.zh: 中大同元年，天子乃詔通用足陌。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongdatong, the Son of Heaven edicted universal use of full strings.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongdatong year 1 the emperor edicted universal use of full strings.

sentences.zh: 詔下而人不從，錢陌益少。

translations.literal: Edict issued yet people did not follow; coin strings increasingly few.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was issued yet people did not follow; coin strings grew ever shorter.

sentences.zh: 至于末年，遂以三十五為百云。

translations.literal: Reaching the final years, then with thirty-five as a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: By the final years, thirty-five counted as a hundred.

sentences.zh: 陳初，承梁喪亂之後，鐵錢不行。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chen, inheriting Liang's post-chaos condition, iron coin did not circulate.
translations.idiomatic: At Chen's founding, inheriting Liang's post-chaos condition, iron coin did not circulate.

sentences.zh: 始梁末又有兩柱錢及鵝眼錢，于時人雜用，其價同，但兩柱重而鵝眼輕。

translations.literal: At the end of Liang there were also Two-Pillar Coin and Goose-Eye Coin; at the time people mixed use, prices the same—but Two-Pillar heavy and Goose-Eye light.
translations.idiomatic: At Liang's end there were also Two-Pillar Coin and Goose-Eye Coin; people mixed them at the same price—but Two-Pillar was heavy and Goose-Eye light.

sentences.zh: 私家多鎔錢，又間以錫鐵，兼以粟帛為貨。

translations.literal: Private households mostly melted coin; also mixed tin and iron; also used millet and cloth as currency.
translations.idiomatic: Private households mostly melted coin; also mixed tin and iron; millet and cloth were also used as currency.

sentences.zh: 至文帝天嘉五年，改鑄五銖。

translations.literal: By Emperor Wen's Tiancheng fifth year, newly cast Five Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: By Emperor Wen's Tiancheng year 5, Five Zhu was newly cast.

sentences.zh: 初出，一當鵝眼之十。

translations.literal: First issued, one equaled ten Goose-Eye.
translations.idiomatic: At first issue, one equaled ten Goose-Eye.

sentences.zh: 宣帝太建十一年，又鑄大貨六銖，以一當五銖之十，與五銖並行。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan's Taijian eleventh year, also cast Great Currency Six Zhu, one equaled ten Five Zhu, circulating with Five Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan's Taijian year 11 also cast Great Currency Six Zhu, one equaling ten Five Zhu, circulating with Five Zhu.

sentences.zh: 後還當一，人皆不便。

translations.literal: Later returned to one; people all found it inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Later it returned to one-to-one; people all found it inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 乃相與訛言曰：「六銖錢有不利縣官之象。

translations.literal: Then mutually spread false words saying: 'Six Zhu coin has an omen unfavorable to the county office.
translations.idiomatic: Then false rumors spread saying: 'Six Zhu coin has an omen unfavorable to the county office.

sentences.zh: 」未幾而帝崩，遂廢六銖而行五銖。

translations.literal: ' Before long the emperor died; then abolished Six Zhu and circulated Five Zhu.
